title: ProgAgent: Learning Tool Orchestration through Programmatic Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.14774v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly expected to orchestrate diverse tools over long-horizon tasks. Existing agents typically use Direct Tool Calling (DTC), where the model invokes tools sequentially, and tool responses accumulate in the model context, which can lead to context rot and orchestration breakdown. In contrast, Programmatic Tool Calling (PTC) invokes tools through executable code and stores intermediate results in runtime variables rather than appending them to the context. Prior work has explored PTC mainly as an inference-time optimization, but its benefits for agentic training remain unclear, and suitable verifiable training tasks are scarce. In this work, we introduce ProgAgent, a full PTC training stack, comprising a pipeline for synthesizing verifiable long-horizon tasks, a lightweight PTC runtime, and a two-stage training recipe. translated_title: ProgAgent：通过程序化训练学习工具编排
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越被期望在长程任务中编排多样化的工具。现有智能体通常采用直接工具调用（DTC），即模型按顺序调用工具，工具响应会不断累积在模型上下文中，这可能导致上下文退化（context rot）和编排失效。相比之下，程序化工具调用（PTC）通过可执行代码调用工具，并将中间结果存储在运行时变量中，而不是将其追加到上下文里。先前的工作主要将PTC视为一种推理时优化手段，但其对智能体训练的收益仍不明确，且合适的可验证训练任务十分稀缺。在本工作中，我们提出了ProgAgent，一个完整的PTC训练栈，包含一个用于合成可验证长程任务的流水线、一个轻量级PTC运行时，以及一个两阶段训练方案。仅使用在四种环境规模下实例化的215个任务，ProgAgent就取得了显著的性能提升。
tldr: ProgAgent提出了首个完整的程序化工具调用（PTC）训练栈，通过可验证长程任务合成流水线、轻量级PTC运行时和两阶段训练方案，仅用215个任务即显著提升了LLM智能体的长程工具编排能力。
en_tdlr: ProgAgent introduces a full Programmatic Tool Calling (PTC) training stack—combining a pipeline for synthesizing verifiable long-horizon tasks, a lightweight PTC runtime, and a two-stage training recipe—that significantly improves LLM agents' long-horizon tool orchestration using only 215 tasks.
